_note: Story 048: when the client asks for a fix during the service. asks: her service-talk lines (and the redo line) that open a request of that kind. patterns: case-insensitive regular expressions that catch the same ask in her AI replies during the service. A request is fixed once the player has used a fix tool (Clean up, Remover) after she asked and the nails then meet the kind's test: edge = every nail's neatness at least edge.minNeatness; length = shorter (or longer, if she asked for longer) than when she asked; colour = a different base colour than when she asked, painted to at least colour.minCoverage on average. fixedMood / openMood: her mood change when it is fixed, or still open at Done. skills: problem handling is at least fixedFloor when every request was fixed, at most openCap when one was left open. lines: what she says (thanks when fixed, open when still not fixed at Done).

edge: Can you fix that edge? It doesn't look even.
Careful, that's a little too close to my skin.
colour: Hmm… actually, I'm not sure about this colour. Could we try a different one?
length: Can you make them a little shorter, please?

thanks: Oh, that's much better. Thank you!
Perfect, the edge looks clean now. Thanks!
open: Hmm, the edge still isn't clean… but okay.
You didn't fix that edge I mentioned. Oh well.

thanks: Oh, I love this one so much more. Thank you!
Yes, this colour is perfect. Thank you for changing it!
open: So… we're keeping the old colour? Okay, I guess.
I did ask for a different colour… never mind.

thanks: Oh yes, that length is much better. Thank you!
Perfect, that's just the length I wanted. Thanks!
open: Hmm, they're still the same length… okay.
I did ask about the length… never mind.
